36005.title: Policy Evaluation Beyond Significance Testing: Evidence from Chicago's ShotSpotter Contract
36005.zh_title: 超越显著性检验的政策评估：来自芝加哥ShotSpotter合同的证据
36005.authors: Terence Chau, Philip J. Cook, Javier Lopez, Jens Ludwig, Alejandro Roemer, Adam K. Soliman
36005.zh_abstract_excerpt: 统计上不显著的项目影响估计通常被认为难以为政策选择提供指导，即使经济上重要的效应仍然可信。在此类情况下，与决策相关的任务不仅仅是检验效应是否异于零，而是估计项目效应的概率分布。当评估相对于使收益超过成本所需的效应而言统计功效不足时，超越假设检验的重要性尤为明显。我们利用芝加哥的ShotSpotter合同来说明这一点。ShotSpotter是一种声学枪声探测系统，可缩短警察响应时间，因而可能提高枪击受害者的存活率。
36005.abstract: Program impact estimates that are not statistically significant are often treated as providing little guidance for policy choice, even when economically important effects remain plausible. In such cases, the decision-relevant task is not simply to test whether the effect differs from zero, but to estimate the probability distribution of programmatic effects. The importance of going beyond hypothesis testing is especially clear when evaluations are underpowered relative to the effect needed for benefits to exceed costs. We illustrate this point using Chicago’s contract for ShotSpotter, an acoustical gunshot detection system that reduces police response times and may therefore have improved survival among shooting victims. Using a geographic RD design, we estimate that ShotSpotter reduced the shooting fatality rate by 2.5 percentage points, equivalent to roughly 49 fewer deaths per year. Although the estimate is not statistically significant, its implied benefit far exceeds the cost of the service. To have enough statistical power under the hypothesis testing approach to detect an effect of this size would require 87 years’ worth of Chicago shooting data. We instead implement a decision-relevant perspective using Bayesian analysis, treating the life-saving effect as a random variable. We find positive expected net benefits, with posterior probabilities that benefits exceed costs ranging from 70% under a flat prior and a $0.5 million value of statistical life to 99.6% under a no-harm prior and a $13.6 million value. The results illustrate how reliance on statistical significance can discard decision-relevant evidence when economically meaningful effects are difficult to detect precisely.

36004.title: The Main Monetary Policy Shock
36004.authors: Christoph Boehm, Husang Kim, T. Niklas Kroner
36004.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们提出一种新方法，将主要货币政策（MMP）冲击识别为最能解释宏观经济波动的货币政策意外变化的线性组合。使用两个标准的高频收益率曲线意外变化以及Boehm和Kroner（2024）的非收益率冲击实施后，MMP冲击解释了过去30年中不可忽视的商业周期变异，这与先前发现形成对比。此外，MMP冲击与教科书式的货币政策冲击显著不同：紧缩性冲击使利率基本不变，但持续压低总体价格并使美元升值，同时暂时收紧金融条件并抑制工业生产。
36004.abstract: We propose a novel procedure to identify a main monetary policy (MMP) shock as the linear combination of monetary policy surprises that best explains macroeconomic fluctuations. Implemented with two standard high-frequency yield-curve surprises and the Boehm and Kroner (2024) non-yield shock, the MMP shock explains nontrivial business-cycle variation over the last 30 years, in contrast with prior findings. Moreover, the MMP shock differs markedly from a textbook monetary policy shock: a contractionary shock leaves interest rates mostly unchanged but persistently lowers headline prices and appreciates the dollar, while temporarily tightening financial conditions and depressing industrial production.

36003.title: AI as Shared Business Infrastructure: Firm Growth and the Distribution of Gains
36003.zh_title: 作为共享商业基础设施的AI：企业成长与收益分配
36003.authors: Panle Jia Barwick, Lu Fang, Jinhan Liu, Huilan Xu, Zhe Yuan
36003.zh_abstract_excerpt: 生成式AI改善了单项任务的绩效，但这些收益能否转化为企业成长、以及哪些企业受益，仍是未解问题。我们研究中国一家领先电商平台，该平台于2024年将生成式AI系统嵌入企业用于经营业务的运营软件中，依托集中开发的模型和平台范围的数据，向每家企业提供即用型应用。每家企业AI使用的完整记录与其月度运营和销售相链接，使我们能够追踪从商业能力变化（如触达客户和推出新产品）到销售增长的采用过程。
36003.abstract: Generative AI improves performance on individual tasks, but whether those gains translate into firm growth, and for which firms, remains an open question. We study a leading Chinese e-commerce platform that in 2024 embedded a generative AI system in the operating software firms use to run their businesses, drawing on centrally developed models and platform-wide data to deliver ready-to-use applications to every firm. Complete records of each firm’s AI use, linked to its monthly operations and sales, let us trace adoption through changes in business capabilities, such as reaching customers and introducing new products, to sales growth. Using a matched difference-in-differences design and focusing on firms with annual sales below RMB 5 million, we find that adoption raises monthly sales by 51.6%, primarily through a 47.0% increase in the number of orders; instrumental-variable estimates confirm these results. Adopters reach more customers, update their product lines faster, and deliver better product and service quality, with the largest proportional gains for the smallest firms. Two mechanisms help explain the results. First, AI lowers the cost of routine work: adopters produce more product content and change listings more often while spending less staff time per order, and the gains are largest for firms that faced the highest costs relative to sales before adoption. Second, AI reduces information frictions: adopters post richer product information, and the gains are largest in markets where demand is hard to predict and matching quality is poor, especially for small firms. At the market level, product categories with greater pre-existing information frictions see more sales by existing firms, more entry, and more new products. AI expands markets rather than merely shifting sales from non-adopters to adopters.

36002.title: Knowledge Without Taxation? Experimental Evidence from a Tax Education Program
36002.zh_title: 无税收的知识？来自税收教育项目的实验证据
36002.authors: Anders Jensen, Nikhil Kumar, Konstantin Poensgen
36002.zh_abstract_excerpt: 加纳的一项房产税实验随机向房产所有者和一线官员提供税收教育。该干预提高了税收知识，知识通过社交网络传播至未受处理的邻居，但并未增加税款缴纳。受过教育的纳税人和官员在互动中更加投入，但并未形成更具合作性的关系。纳税人下调了对执法能力的信念，并更加了解减轻税负的合法途径。知识是一把双刃剑：它可以激励公民参与税收体系，同时暴露国家有限的执法能力。
36002.abstract: A property tax experiment in Ghana randomly provides tax education to property owners and frontline officials. The intervention raises tax knowledge, which spreads through social networks to untreated neighbors, but does not increase tax payments. Educated taxpayers and officials become more engaged in their interactions without developing more collaborative relationships. Taxpayers revise downward their beliefs about enforcement capacity and become more aware of legal ways to reduce their tax burden. Knowledge is a double-edged sword: it can stimulate citizens to engage with the tax system while exposing the state's limited capacity to enforce it.

36001.title: Vigilance, Risk Vulnerability, and the Precautionary Augment
36001.zh_title: 警觉性、风险脆弱性与预防性增量
36001.authors: Miles S. Kimball, Vincent A. Mastantuno
36001.zh_abstract_excerpt: 风险提高了审慎主体的预期边际效用。我们将这一比例变化定义为预防性增量，它衡量风险引致的储蓄边际价值、Lucas树无风险利率以及衍生品饱和市场中资产价格的变化，在该市场中市场状态证券对特质风险提供不完整覆盖。若某主体对所有不公平风险的预防性增量都更大，则其比另一主体更警觉。我们推导并比较了更高警觉性的条件，展示了如何几何化地实施Diffidence定理。由于风险脆弱性等价于警觉性递减，关于风险脆弱性的经典结果作为推论出现。
36001.abstract: Risk raises the expected marginal utility of a prudent agent. We define this proportional change as the precautionary augment, which measures risk-induced changes in the marginal value of saving, the Lucas Tree risk-free rate, and asset prices in a derivative-saturated market where market-state securities provide incomplete coverage against idiosyncratic risk. One agent is more vigilant than another if their precautionary augment is larger for all unfair risks. We derive and compare conditions for greater vigilance, showing how to implement the Diffidence Theorem geometrically. Because risk vulnerability is equivalent to decreasing vigilance, classic results about risk vulnerability emerge as corollaries.

36000.title: When More Prenatal Care Looks Like Less: Selection, Information and Maternal and Infant Health
36000.zh_title: 当更多产前护理看起来像更少：选择、信息与母婴健康
36000.authors: Chien-Tzu Cheng, Shin-Yi Chou, Hsien-Ming Lien
36000.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们利用台湾2003年SARS疫情作为自然实验，以孕期暴露于SARS引发的恐惧作为产前护理的工具变量，该恐惧使就诊次数减少超过20%。充足的产前护理使可预防的孕产妇并发症降低3.4个百分点（26%），对婴儿结局无影响。OLS估计对孕产妇并发症的符号反常，但高估了婴儿结局的收益，这与患者驱动和提供者驱动的竞争性选择一致。
36000.abstract: We use Taiwan's 2003 SARS epidemic as a natural experiment, instrumenting prenatal care with gestational exposure to SARS-induced fear that reduced visits by over 20 percent. Adequate prenatal care reduces preventable maternal complications by 3.4 percentage points (26 percent), with no effect on infant outcomes. OLS estimates are perversely signed for maternal complications but overstate benefits for infant outcomes, consistent with competing patient- and provider-driven selection. Mechanism evidence points to prenatal care as a longitudinal information system: repeated contact facilitates detection of evolving risks and generates clinical information that informs delivery decisions, including delivery-mode routing and subsequent management at delivery.

36036.title: How Does Capital Flow To Poor Countries? Evidence from Venture Capital and Private Equity
36036.zh_title: 资本如何流向贫穷国家？来自风险投资和私募股权的证据
36036.authors: Emanuele Colonnelli, Marcio Cruz, Josh Lerner, Mariana Pereira-Lopez, Yuanchang Wei
36036.zh_abstract_excerpt: 为什么流向贫穷国家的私人资本如此之少？我们通过一项实验性调查，研究了风险投资和私募股权投资者如何评估不同国家的企业。该调查覆盖108个国家的1,485名投资者，并通过激励措施促使他们评估具有随机化企业特征、地点和投资条款的假设性投资机会。投资者对企业基本面的反应相似，但除此之外条件可比的企业在较贫穷国家获得的兴趣要低得多。这种贫穷国家惩罚在专注于新兴市场的投资者中要小得多。
36036.abstract: Why does so little private capital flow to poor countries? We study how venture capital and private equity investors evaluate firms across countries, using an experimental survey of 1,485 investors in 108 countries who are incentivized to evaluate hypothetical investment opportunities with randomized firm characteristics, locations, and investment terms. Investors respond similarly to firm fundamentals, but otherwise comparable firms attract substantially less interest in poorer countries. This poor-country penalty is much smaller among investors specialized in emerging markets. Detailed survey data show that emerging market and developed market investors have largely similar investment practices, but differ in how they obtain country information, assess and manage country risks, and exit investments. Investors reporting active country-risk management apply smaller country penalties, even after accounting for market focus. Our findings suggest that investors' specialization and investment practices shape how country risk affects investment: the same firm can face drastically different financing prospects depending on where it is located and which investors evaluate it.
36036.zh_abstract: 为什么流向贫穷国家的私人资本如此之少？我们通过一项实验性调查，研究了风险投资和私募股权投资者如何评估不同国家的企业。该调查覆盖108个国家的1,485名投资者，并通过激励措施促使他们评估具有随机化企业特征、地点和投资条款的假设性投资机会。投资者对企业基本面的反应相似，但除此之外条件可比的企业在较贫穷国家获得的兴趣要低得多。这种贫穷国家惩罚在专注于新兴市场的投资者中要小得多。详细的调查数据显示，新兴市场和发达市场投资者的投资实践大体相似，但在获取国家信息、评估和管理国家风险以及退出投资的方式上存在差异。报告积极进行国家风险管理的投资者施加的国家惩罚较小，即使在考虑了市场专注度之后也是如此。我们的发现表明，投资者的专业化和投资实践塑造了国家风险如何影响投资：同一家企业可能因所在地不同以及由哪些投资者评估而面临截然不同的融资前景。

36035.title: Will AI Growth Reach the Developing World?
36035.zh_title: AI增长会惠及发展中国家吗？
36035.authors: Daniel Björkegren, David Lagakos, Mitchell VanVuren
36035.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文探讨AI驱动的经济增长将如何影响发展中国家。我们的分析基于一个发达经济体和发展中经济体的增长模型，其中AI服务在世界市场上交易，并可能替代或互补生产中的不同劳动投入。偏好设定允许对AI所提供服务的需求存在上限的可能性。模型预测，发展中国家可能无法从AI驱动的增长中获益那么多。首先，它们可能缺乏在国内充分利用AI所需的互补技能。其次，由于相对较低的生产率，它们可能在世界市场中被价格挤出。
36035.abstract: This paper explores how economic growth driven by AI will impact the developing world. Our analysis is based on a growth model of a developed and developing economy where AI services are traded on the world market, and may substitute for or complement different labor inputs in production. Preferences allow for the possibility that demand for services provided by AI has an upper bound. The model predicts that developing countries may not benefit as much from AI-driven growth. First, they may lack complementary skills needed to fully utilize AI domestically. Second, they may be priced out of world markets due to their relatively lower productivity. We use our model to simulate how growth and welfare are affected by making workers more complementary to AI, subsidizing compute, speeding technology diffusion, and providing cash transfers. Numerical simulations of the model suggest that the potential for developing countries to be left behind – or having some workers lose in absolute terms – is substantial enough that researchers should study the impacts of AI on developing countries in real time.

36034.title: The Recent and Impending Evolution of US Federal Support for State and Local Governments
36034.zh_title: 美国联邦对州和地方政府支持的近期与即将到来的演变
36034.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在美国联邦体制中，联邦政府向州和地方政府提供大量财政支持。在本文中，我们描述了2025年超过1.2万亿美元的政府间拨款格局在COVID-19大流行期间及之后如何演变。我们提供了关于州和地方政府预算在大流行时期财政支持逐步退出时如何调整的短期证据。我们进一步强调，随着《One Big Beautiful Bill Act》（OBBBA）中旨在限制政府间拨款的若干条款在未来几年生效，州和地方预算将面临的压力。
36034.abstract: In the US federal system, the federal government provides substantial fiscal support to state and local governments. In this paper, we describe how the landscape of intergovernmental grants, which exceeded $1.2 trillion in 2025, evolved during and in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic. We provide short-run evidence on how state and local government budgets have adapted as pandemic-era fiscal supports wound down. We further emphasize the pressures state and local budgets will face as several provisions of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA), which are intended to restrain intergovernmental grants, go into effect over the coming years.

36033.title: Preconception Medicaid and Maternal and Infant Health: Evidence from Linked Administrative Data
36033.zh_title: 孕前Medicaid与母婴健康：来自关联行政数据的证据
36033.authors: Genna Campain, Sarah Miller, Petra Persson, Maya Rossin-Slater, Laura Wherry, Katlyn N. King
36033.zh_abstract_excerpt: 尽管美国有针对怀孕的公共保险覆盖，低收入母亲和婴儿仍面临持续的健康劣势。利用关联的出生、税务和参保数据，我们考察了加州2014年Medicaid扩展带来的孕前覆盖的影响，比较了收入资格阈值两侧首次生育母亲的结果变化。扩展使孕前Medicaid参保增加了3.4个月（12个月连续覆盖增加23个百分点），妊娠第一个月参保增加24个百分点，并提高了充分产前护理和性传播感染筛查。然而，我们未发现母婴健康有所改善，这表明仅靠孕前覆盖无法弥合健康差距。
36033.abstract: Despite pregnancy-focused public insurance coverage in the U.S., low-income mothers and infants face persistent health disadvantages. Using linked birth, tax, and enrollment data, we examine the effects of preconception coverage from California's 2014 Medicaid expansion, comparing changes in outcomes for first-time mothers just below and above the income eligibility threshold. Expansion increased preconception Medicaid enrollment by 3.4 months (+23 percentage points in 12-month continuous coverage), first-month pregnancy enrollment by 24 percentage points, and adequate prenatal care and STI screening. Yet we find no improvements in maternal or infant health, suggesting preconception coverage alone cannot close health disparities.

36032.title: Clouds of Credit: Mapping the Financial Web Behind AI Compute
36032.zh_title: 信贷之云：绘制AI算力背后的金融网络
36032.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们绘制了支撑AI建设的金融网络。大量股权缓冲保护债权人免受2026年中期巨额未偿债务的影响，但集中敞口和相互关联的债权形成了薄弱环节。我们校准的模型支持未来几年大规模的算力扩张。均衡投资超过社会最优，因为企业未将其对竞争对手收入的影响内部化。债务为扩张融资近60%，提高了杠杆率，而无追索权借款使项目贷款人尽管有股权缓冲仍面临敞口。在低生产率状态下，股东和债权人的损失达到16.8万亿美元，债务的违约损失率为40%。
36032.abstract: We map the financial network supporting the AI buildout. Substantial equity cushions protect creditors against large obligations outstanding in mid-2026, but concentrated exposures and interconnected claims create weak links. Our calibrated model supports a large compute expansion in the coming years. The equilibrium investment exceeds the social optimum because firms do not internalize their effects on competitors' revenues. Debt finances nearly 60% of the expansion, increasing leverage, while non-recourse borrowing leaves project lenders exposed despite equity buffers. In the low-productivity state, losses reach $16.8 trillion across shareholders and creditors, with 40% loss-given-default on debt. Suppressing contractual payment spillovers among the key firms reduces private losses by approximately 30%, revealing substantial network propagation.

36031.title: A Blessing in Disguise: The Long-Term Effects of Childhood Exposure to the Boll Weevil on Old-Age Male Longevity
36031.zh_title: 因祸得福：童年接触棉铃象鼻虫对老年男性寿命的长期影响
36031.zh_abstract_excerpt: 臭名昭著的农业害虫棉铃象鼻虫在1892年至1920年间蔓延至美国南部各县。它对棉花生产造成了毁灭性影响，而棉花是一种高度依赖童工的作物。本研究考察棉铃象鼻虫的到来及随后童工减少如何影响晚年死亡率结果。利用与社会保障局死亡记录相关联的1940年人口普查数据，我们记录了棉铃象鼻虫的交错蔓延改善了暴露男性儿童的寿命。完全暴露于棉铃象鼻虫与意向性治疗效应相关，即寿命延长1-3个月。
36031.abstract: The infamous agricultural pest, the boll weevil, spread across southern US counties between 1892 and 1920. It had devastating impacts on cotton production, a highly child-labor-intensive crop. This study examines how the arrival of the boll weevil and the subsequent reductions in child labor affect later-life mortality outcomes. Using Social Security Administration death records linked with the 1940 census, we document that the staggered spread of the boll weevil improved the longevity of exposed male children. Full exposure to the boll weevil is associated with an intent-to-treat effect of 1-3 months of higher longevity. We show that the estimated effects are robust across a wide array of specifications, are not driven by sociodemographic and socioeconomic compositional change in the final sample, and are not associated with pre-existing trends in the outcome. Further, we find larger impacts among Blacks, children of lower educated mothers, whose fathers work in the farming industry, and those born in high cotton intensity counties. Moreover, the effects appear to be substantially larger among children in states with less restrictive child labor policies, implying the role of these policies in reducing the adverse effects of child labor in the absence of the boll weevil in cotton production counties. Affected children are more likely to migrate, and their destination counties are more likely to be urban and have higher socioeconomic scores. The 1940 census suggests that the exposed children attain higher levels of education and have higher socioeconomic scores. We discuss the policy implications of these results in relation to child labor and school attendance policies in developing countries.

36030.title: Learn to Earn: The Long-Term Effects of Foundational Learning
36030.zh_title: 学会赚钱：基础学习的长期影响
36030.authors: Tahir Andrabi, Natalie Bau, Jishnu Das, Asim Ijaz Khwaja, Catherine Michaud-Leclerc
36030.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们追踪巴基斯坦学生超过15年，采用两种识别策略，首次提供了将小学阶段学习与低收入国家成年后结果联系起来的因果证据。就读于考试成绩增值更高的学校，会提高15年后的教育程度和收入。一项随机信息干预在村庄层面带来了学习收益，也产生了类似效果。所有就读于高出1个标准差学校的学生，其终生收入增益合计为175,000美元；对于信息干预，男性的公共资金边际价值为无穷大。投资于学习具有强有力的经济理由。
36030.abstract: Tracking Pakistani students over 15 years, we use two identification strategies to provide the first causal evidence linking learning in primary school to adult outcomes in a low-income country. Exposure to a school with higher test score value-added increases educational attainment and earnings 15 years later. A randomized information intervention that led to learning gains at the village level generated similar effects. Lifetime earnings gains across all students attending a 1sd better school total US$175,000, and for the information intervention, the marginal value of public funds is infinity for men. There is a strong economic case for investing in learning.

36029.title: Childhood Learning and Adult Earnings in Four LMIC Cohorts
36029.zh_title: 四个中低收入国家队列中的儿童期学习与成年收入
36029.authors: Jishnu Das, Yash Dhuldhoya, Marta Favara, Amory Gethin, Alan Sánchez, Abhijeet Singh
36029.zh_abstract_excerpt: 低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的研究者和政策制定者通常依赖间接证据来证明投资于学习的合理性，方法是将考试成绩与经济增长联系起来，或将成人认知评估与收入联系起来。这种对间接证据的依赖在很大程度上源于将学龄期学习与成年收入联系起来的纵向数据稀缺。我们利用埃塞俄比亚、印度、巴基斯坦和秘鲁的数据来填补这一空白，估计以12岁左右的考试成绩衡量的基础学习（FL）与成年早期人力资本和收入之间的关联。
36029.abstract: Researchers and policymakers in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) have customarily relied on indirect evidence to justify investments in learning, either by linking test scores to economic growth or by connecting adult cognitive assessments to earnings. This reliance on indirect evidence largely stems from the scarcity of longitudinal data linking school-age learning to adult earnings. We address this gap by using data from Ethiopia, India, Pakistan, and Peru to estimate associations between foundational learning (FL), measured by test scores around age 12, and human capital and earnings in young adulthood. In Peru, India, and Pakistan, a one-standard-deviation increase in FL is associated with an 8-13 log point increase in adult earnings. Childhood scores also predict 1.1-1.5 additional years of schooling and 9.3-13.5 percentage points higher college or vocational attendance, as well as higher skills in adulthood. Interestingly, a linear-projection decomposition indicates that measured schooling and adult test scores explain between 18% (Peru) to 50-56% (India and Pakistan) of the FL-earnings gradient, suggesting that FL may raise earnings over and above the association with schooling and adult scores. Finally, FL can account for about 5-12 percent of the earnings gap between young Ethiopians and Indians in our sample, a number that could rise to 33 percent as returns to learning grow over the life cycle. We interpret these descriptive findings in light of recent causal evidence on the learning-to-earnings pipeline and discuss the implications for policy investments in FL.

36028.title: Crash Injuries and Fatalities in the United States Following Standardization of Automatic Emergency Braking
36028.zh_title: 美国自动紧急制动标准化后的碰撞伤害和死亡
36028.authors: Vishal Patel, Christopher M. Worsham, Michael Liu-Hass, Thomas Tsai, Anupam Jena
36028.zh_abstract_excerpt: 车辆安全技术是否减少碰撞伤害和死亡对消费者和监管者具有相关性，但严格的现实世界证据有限，因为选择可选功能的驾驶员与不选择者不同。作为自然实验，我们利用2017年至2022年间39款车型将自动紧急制动作为标准而非可选设备的分阶段实施。在全美国范围内，由该车辆造成的追尾碰撞伤害百分比在第一个标准车型年从13.9%降至8.0%，碰撞死亡百分比从6.0%降至4.7%。
36028.abstract: Whether vehicle safety technologies reduce crash injuries and fatalities is relevant to consumers and regulators, but rigorous real world evidence is limited because drivers who choose optional features differ from those who do not. As a natural experiment, we leveraged the staggered implementation of automatic emergency braking as standard rather than optional equipment on 39 vehicle models between 2017 and 2022. Across the United States, the percentage of crash injuries from rear-end collisions caused by the vehicle fell from 13.9% to 8.0% at the first standard model year, and the percentage of crash fatalities fell from 6.0% to 4.7%. Neither fell in models that never standardized the technology, and crash types it was not designed to prevent were unaffected. Automatic emergency braking reduces crash injuries and fatalities.

36027.title: Federal Eminent Domain and Interstate Energy Infrastructure: Evidence from History
36027.zh_title: 联邦征用权与州际能源基础设施：来自历史的证据
36027.authors: Zachary Liscow, Joseph S. Shapiro, Heidi L. Williams
36027.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们分析一个历史事件，以生成关于联邦征用权如何影响能源运输基础设施建设证据。1947年《天然气法》修正案赋予联邦批准的州际天然气管道在与土地所有者谈判失败时通过征用权获得通行权的权力。我们使用新数字化的历史政府记录和行业媒体列表，比较州际天然气管道建设与石油管道和州内天然气管道建设，后两者均未直接受改革影响。1947年后，州际天然气管道里程的年增量增长了近六倍，而石油管道增长保持稳定，州际里程的增益几乎是州内管道增益的五倍。
36027.abstract: We analyze a historical episode to generate evidence on how federal eminent domain authority affected construction of energy transportation infrastructure. The 1947 amendment to the Natural Gas Act gave federally approved interstate natural gas pipelines the power to acquire rights of way by eminent domain when negotiations with landowners failed. We compare construction of interstate gas pipelines with construction of oil pipelines and of within-state gas pipelines, neither of which was directly affected by the reform, using newly digitized historical government records and trade press listings. After 1947, annual additions to interstate gas pipeline mileage rose nearly sixfold while oil pipeline growth held steady, and the gain in interstate mileage was nearly five times the gain for within-state pipelines. Both comparisons suggest that the amendment substantially increased interstate gas pipeline construction. We discuss what this historical evidence implies for current congressional proposals to provide federal eminent domain authority for interstate electricity transmission.

36026.title: Crime on ICE: Local Police Behavior and Immigration Enforcement in the United States
36026.zh_title: ICE上的犯罪：美国地方警察行为与移民执法
36026.authors: John J. Donohue, Tai Markman, Eric A. Baldwin
36026.zh_abstract_excerpt: 越来越多的地方警察部门现在拥有执行联邦移民法的权力，这一角色传统上保留给联邦官员。尽管声称这一权力增强了公共安全，但经验证据仍然有限。我们使用2000-2024年FBI统一犯罪报告数据，利用美国司法管辖区的分阶段采用来估计对警务的因果影响。我们发现，这一执法权力使低级别、自由裁量犯罪的逮捕增加了约7%，而犯罪率或严重犯罪没有相应下降。这些结果表明，此类协议将警察优先事项重新调整为自由裁量执法，而没有可衡量的公共安全益处。
36026.abstract: A growing number of local police departments now hold authority to enforce federal immigration law, a role traditionally reserved for federal officers. Despite claims that this authority enhances public safety, empirical evidence remains limited. Using FBI Uniform Crime Report data from 2000–2024, we exploit staggered adoption across U.S. jurisdictions to estimate causal effects on policing. We find that this enforcement authority increases arrests for low-level, discretionary offenses by approximately 7%, with no corresponding decreases in offense rates or serious crime. These results suggest that such agreements realign police priorities toward discretionary enforcement without measurable public safety benefits.

36025.abstract: Observational associations between red meat consumption and cardiometabolic disease are confounded by diet and other health behaviors. Alpha-gal syndrome, a tick-borne allergy to mammalian meat, leads to an abrupt and involuntary cessation of red meat consumption. Using national electronic health records, we compared changes in weight and cardiometabolic health over two years before and after newly detected alpha-gal syndrome with those in patients with other tick-borne diseases, who were also bitten and sought care but whose diagnoses carry no dietary restriction. Not eating red meat appears to yield modest but measurable cardiometabolic benefits.

36024.title: Aging and Structural Change: Cost Disease in the Care Sector
36024.zh_title: 老龄化与结构变迁：护理部门中的成本病
36024.authors: Nick Pretnar, Finn Kydland, Tonya Y. Kydland
36024.zh_abstract_excerpt: 对于大多数服务业而言，市场生产率增长已将生产从家庭中拉出。我们表明，正规护理是一个例外，因为其生产率增长为负。一个包含非正规护理的两部门一般均衡世代交叠模型将正规护理相对价格的上升归因于这一下降，而非人口结构。护理/非护理之间的互补性主导了正规/非正规之间的互补性。随着正规价格上升，老年人以非护理消费替代正规护理，将护理转移给非正规照护者。如果非护理生产率上升或进入队列增长，且其影响被下降的护理需求所抵消，人口老龄化未必会减缓增长。
36024.abstract: For most of the service sector, market productivity growth has pulled production out of the home. We show that formal nursing care is an exception because its productivity growth has been negative. A two-sector general equilibrium overlapping generations model with informal care attributes the rise in formal care's relative price to this decline, not demography. Care/non-care complementarity dominates formal/informal complementarity. As formal prices rise, elders substitute non-care consumption for formal care, shifting care onto informal caregivers. Population aging need not slow growth if non-care productivity rises or entering cohorts grow and its effects are offset by declining care needs.

36023.title: The Role of Parental Beliefs and Public Policies in Financing Higher Education: An Experimental Study
36023.zh_title: 父母信念与公共政策在高等教育融资中的作用：一项实验研究
36023.authors: Francesco Agostinelli, Guglielmo Briscese, Giovanni M. Topa
36023.zh_abstract_excerpt: 希望为子女追求高等教育提供经济支持的父母，必须基于对大学费用以及资金来源的假设进行储蓄。本研究考察父母信念和未来借贷成本如何塑造大学储蓄决策。通过一项嵌入财务规划工具的调查实验，我们引出父母对大学未来费用的信念以及他们对不同资金来源（包括经济援助和学生贷款）的预期。我们发现，几乎所有父母都希望覆盖部分未来大学费用，但许多人可能因低估未来支出和高估可用经济援助而在储蓄上不足。一项纠正性信息干预促使大多数父母重新校准其储蓄目标。
36023.abstract: Parents who want to financially support their child’s pursuit of higher education must save against assumptions about what college will cost and how it will be funded. This study examines how parental beliefs and future borrowing costs shape college saving decisions. Through a survey experiment with an embedded financial planning tool, we elicit parental beliefs about the future costs of college and their expectations of different funding sources, including financial aid and student loans. We find that nearly all parents want to cover some of the future costs of college, but many may fall short in their savings due to underestimating future expenses and overestimating available financial aid. A corrective information intervention encourages most parents to recalibrate their saving target. However, when a substantial gap between expected and actual costs is combined with a salient high repayment burden for their child, we find a discouragement effect that diminishes both their willingness to save and their aspirations for their child’s educational attainment. We calibrate a model of parental saving with learning about college costs, which reproduces both the absence of an average response to borrowing costs and the shift of children away from college attendance, and use it to price the welfare cost of misperception. Parents with higher financial literacy hold better-calibrated beliefs and respond more to correction. We discuss policy implications for outreach activities to support informed financial planning for college education.

36022.title: The Last Arbitrage? Capital Flows, Development, and Infrastructure as an Asset Class
36022.zh_title: 最后的套利？资本流动、发展与作为资产类别的基础设施
36022.authors: Anusha Chari, Monroe Gamble, Peter Blair Henry
36022.zh_abstract_excerpt: Lucas（1990）追问为何资本不从富国流向穷国。当穷国在1980年代末向外国投资者开放股票市场时，资本确实流入了：富国资本套利掉了新兴市场股票的超额回报，并创造了一个新的资产类别。基础设施可能提供最后这样的套利机会。在自由化时期，穷国铺装道路的社会回报中位数为美国资本回报的3.7倍，但投资者只能获取合同、使用者收费和政治风险所允许的那部分社会回报，我们将这一约束称为私人外国门槛。
36022.abstract: Lucas (1990) asked why capital does not flow from rich to poor countries. When poor countries opened their stock markets to foreign investors in the late 1980s, it did: rich-country capital arbitraged away the excess return on emerging-market equity and created a new asset class. Infrastructure may offer the last such arbitrage. The median social return on paved roads in poor countries was 3.7 times the return on U.S. capital at the time of liberalization, but investors capture only the share of social returns that contracts, user fees, and political risk allow, a constraint we call the private foreign hurdle. Confidential IFC data show that its infrastructure equity portfolio outperformed the S&P 500 by 2 percentage points per year, even though only 41 percent of individual investments in the portfolio did so. This suggests that strong risk-adjusted portfolio returns can mask substantial project-specific uncertainty. Despite high social returns, transportation accounted for just 9 IFC infrastructure project investments versus 157 in power and telecommunications. This raises the question of whether private investors can appropriate enough of the social returns on infrastructure to make these investments. Moreover, investors cannot learn from returns they cannot see. Disclosure of historical equity returns is therefore necessary, but not sufficient, to efficiently mobilize more private capital for infrastructure. Because the benefits of disclosure accrue to the market, not to any one firm, multilateral development banks, working with an independent research partner, are best placed to provide it.

36021.title: Impacts of AI in Higher Education: A Panel Survey of Undergraduates
36021.zh_title: 人工智能在高等教育中的影响：本科生面板调查
36021.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们报告了一轮本科生调查的发现，样本包括达特茅斯学院学生、即将毕业的高中生以及更广泛的美国大学生等独立样本。学生报告在可能有害于学习的任务和可能有助于学习的任务中都广泛使用AI。学生报告同伴滥用AI的程度远高于自己滥用AI的报告。92%的学生同意或强烈同意使用AI对写作有害。由于利用AI作弊，计分课外作业已变得越来越不公平。但学生看到了使用AI实时回答概念性问题、创建练习测验和学习指南以及使研究项目取得有意义且高效进展的价值。
36021.abstract: We report findings from the first wave of a survey of undergraduates including separate samples of Dartmouth students, graduating high school seniors, and U.S. college students more broadly. Students report extensive use of AI both for tasks which are likely harmful to learning and tasks which are likely helpful to learning. Students report much higher peer misuse of AI relative to reports of own misuse. Ninety-two percent of students agree or strongly agree that use of AI is harmful to writing. Use of graded out-of-class assignments has become increasingly unfair due to cheating with AI. But students see the value of using AI to answer conceptual questions in real time, create practice quizzes and study guides and to enable meaningful and efficient progress on research projects. Eighty-four percent of Dartmouth respondents report that AI is changing the nature of jobs in their desired (future) field as opposed to eliminating jobs. AI’s perceived value and harms vary widely by academic discipline suggesting that use, rules, and approaches must also vary greatly based on the discipline and context. Students are largely self-taught in AI but have strong demand for incorporating AI effectively in the curriculum.

36020.title: The Effects of Years of Health Insurance on the Health of Older Adults
36020.zh_title: 医疗保险年限对老年人健康的影响
36020.authors: Yu Liu, Kevin Callison, Robert Kaestner
36020.zh_abstract_excerpt: 更长的医疗保险暴露是否改善健康仍是一个未决的实证问题。本研究利用《平价医疗法案》（ACA）实施前后，对ACA之前已参保和未参保者保险覆盖率的差异变化，考察额外一年医疗保险覆盖的健康效应。使用《健康与退休研究》（HRS）的纵向数据，我们以基线未参保状态与ACA后时期的交互项作为保险持续时间的工具变量。我们发现，相对于基线已参保的受访者，ACA使先前未参保受访者的保险覆盖增加了约一年。
36020.abstract: Whether longer exposure to health insurance improves health remains an open empirical question. This study examines the health effects of an additional year of health insurance coverage by exploiting differential changes in coverage pre-to-post implementation of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) for those who were and were not insured prior to the ACA. Using longitudinal data from the Health and Retirement Study (HRS), we instrument for insurance duration using baseline uninsured status interacted with the post-ACA period. We find that the ACA increased insurance coverage by approximately one additional year among previously uninsured respondents relative to those insured at baseline. Instrumental-variable estimates provide no statistically significant evidence of improvements in self-rated health, depressive symptoms, or hypertension over a four-year follow-up period. These findings are robust across alternative specifications. Overall, results provide little evidence that longer insurance coverage translates into measurable short-term health improvements, while leaving open the possibility of modest or longer-term benefits.

36019.title: Economics of Mental Health
36019.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本章概述了快速演变的心理健康经济学文献，重点关注2015年以来发表的研究。该文献大幅增长，反映了对精神疾病患病率和经济成本的认识提高、污名化下降以及心理健康数据的日益可得。除精神疾病的经济成本外，本综述聚焦四类广泛的心理健康决定因素：禀赋、经济资源、教育和创伤。我们还考察心理健康治疗的决定因素和效果。最后，我们讨论精神疾病的某些特征（包括其发作性和复发性）如何对经典健康资本模型构成挑战。
36019.abstract: This chapter provides an overview of the rapidly evolving economics literature on mental health, focusing on research published since 2015. This literature has grown substantially, reflecting the increased recognition of the prevalence and economic costs of mental illness, declining stigma, and the growing availability of data on mental health. In addition to the economic costs of mental illness, the review focuses on four broad classes of determinants of mental health: endowments, economic resources, education, and trauma. We also examine the determinants and effects of mental health treatment. Finally, we discuss how certain features of mental illness, including its episodic and recurrent nature, pose challenges for the canonical health capital model.

36018.title: Decoding Success: Phonics-based Instruction and Student Achievement
36018.zh_title: 解码成功：基于自然拼读的教学与学生成绩
36018.authors: Alex Hollingsworth, Alberto Ortega, Nikolaos Zirogiannis
36018.zh_abstract_excerpt: 阅读是一项基础技能，但美国四年级学生中阅读达到熟练水平的不足三分之一。如何最好地教授阅读并提高教育成就，数十年来一直是政策辩论的活跃议题。近年来，基于自然拼读的方法人气激增，尽管此前将类似方法引入课堂的最大规模尝试因担心该项目无效而被放弃。本文研究《阅读优先》（Reading First），这是《不让一个孩子掉队》法案下设立的每年近10亿美元的联邦项目，旨在在K-3课堂推广基于自然拼读的教学。
36018.abstract: Reading is a foundational skill, yet fewer than one in three US fourth graders read at a proficient level. How best to teach reading and improve educational attainment has been an active policy debate for decades. Recently, phonics-based approaches have surged in popularity, even though the largest attempt to put similar methods into classrooms was previously abandoned out of concerns that the program was ineffective. This paper studies Reading First, a nearly $1 billion per year federal program established under No Child Left Behind that promoted phonics-based instruction in K-3 classrooms. Exploiting administrative data from Texas and program eligibility formulas, we estimate effects via difference-in-differences and instrumental variables specifications. We find that eligibility increased third-grade reading test scores by 0.1 standard deviations and that effects persisted through at least the eighth grade. An analysis of digitized exam questions shows that treated students outperformed peers on questions that required basic decoding skills and those with more words, a benefit that also drove improvements in math scores. We follow exposed cohorts into early adulthood, finding that the program increased on-time high school graduation, college enrollment, four-year college completion, and adult earnings at age 25.

36017.title: fereg: Fast High-Dimensional Fixed-Effects Regressions in Stata
36017.zh_title: fereg：Stata中的快速高维固定效应回归
36017.zh_abstract_excerpt: 包含许多固定效应的回归是应用研究的核心，但在大型数据集上拟合它们可能很慢。本文介绍命令fereg和feppml，它们拟合具有高维固定效应的线性回归和泊松伪最大似然回归。两个命令都使用熟悉的Stata语法，并将计算传递给编译插件。该插件根据固定效应的结构在投影、Krylov和多网格求解器之间选择，在发布每个结果前进行检查，并在多个处理器核心上运行。
36017.abstract: Regressions with many fixed effects are central to applied research, but fitting them to large datasets can be slow. In this article, I present the commands fereg and feppml, which fit linear and Poisson pseudo-maximum-likelihood regressions with high-dimensional fixed effects. Both commands use familiar Stata syntax and pass the computation to a compiled plugin. The plugin chooses among projection, Krylov, and multigrid solvers according to the structure of the fixed effects, checks every result before posting it, and runs on several processor cores. The commands support multiple and interacted fixed effects, group-specific slopes, regression weights, robust and multiway clustered standard errors, saved fixed effects, and prediction. Two simulated examples illustrate their use. In simulated designs with up to ten million observations and default stopping settings, fereg was 6–204 times faster than reghdfe and feppml 11–103 times faster than ppmlhdfe. The commands were also faster than fixest (R) and PyFixest (Python) in all 53 simulated configurations and than the Julia packages FixedEffectModels.jl and GLFixedEffectModels.jl in 52 of 53, with geometric-mean time ratios between 3.0 and 7.7. On administrative data with 1.2 million workers and 117,000 firms, fereg and feppml were at least 3.4 times faster than every other command at every number of cores.

36016.title: An Odd Approximation of Inflation for State Dependent Pricing Models
36016.zh_title: 状态依存定价模型的一种通胀奇次近似
36016.authors: Luca Gagliardone, Mark Gertler, Simone Lenzu, Joris Tielens, Al-Mahdi Ebsim
36016.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们推导了具有随机菜单成本和战略互补性的状态依存定价模型的加总状态空间表示。该表示从第一性原理推导而来，用价格缺口的有限个矩（前三个）替代其横截面分布，同时保留状态依存定价的关键经济力量——价格调整频率的变动和选择效应。沿脉冲响应，通胀是平均价格缺口的奇次（三次）多项式。嵌入一般均衡环境后，该模型可以通过扰动法求解、滤波，并用标准DSGE工具估计，且在不同冲击规模下与全局解吻合良好。
36016.abstract: We derive an aggregate state-space representation of state-dependent pricing models with random menu costs and strategic complementarities. The representation, derived from first principles, replaces the cross-sectional distribution of price gaps with a finite set of its moments (the first three), while preserving the key economic forces of state-dependent pricing--movements in the frequency of price adjustment and selection. Along the impulse response, inflation is an odd (cubic) polynomial in the average price gap. Embedded in a general equilibrium setting, the model can be solved by perturbation, filtered, and estimated with standard DSGE tools, and it matches well the global solution across shock sizes. Applied to the 2021--22 inflation surge in the United States and the euro area, it shows that much of the variation that linear models would attribute to cost-push shocks is in fact endogenous amplification through the frequency of price changes and selection.

36015.title: Education and Gender Voting Polarization: The Effect of Compulsory Schooling on Sex-Based Preferences for the Democratic and Republican Parties
36015.zh_title: 教育与性别投票极化：义务教育法对民主党和共和党性别偏好的影响
36015.authors: Philip DeCicca, Harry Krashinsky, Erik T. Nesson
36015.zh_abstract_excerpt: 过去40年美国选举政治最显著的发展之一是男性和女性选民之间日益扩大的分歧。1980年，男性和女性对民主党和共和党的支持水平大致相当，而更近期的调查显示，女性相对于男性对民主党的偏好存在约10至15个百分点的差距。我们通过使用多种计量经济学策略，建立义务教育法（CSLs）、教育 attainment 与按性别分化的政治偏好之间的新颖联系，来解释这一结果。
36015.abstract: One of the most notable developments in U.S. electoral politics over the last 40 years is the increasing divide between men and women voters. While men and women had roughly equivalent levels of support for both the Democratic and Republican parties in 1980, more recent surveys have revealed a roughly 10 to 15-percentage-point gap in preference for the Democratic party among women relative to men. We explain this result by using a variety of econometric strategies to establish a novel connection between compulsory schooling laws (CSLs), educational attainment, and diverging political preferences by sex. First, we show that the timing of this divergence is coincident with recent changes in CSLs, and that this divergence is almost entirely due to changes in sex-related preferences for the Democratic party in states where there exists a much stronger effect of CSLs on average educational attainment -- very little change in sex-related preferences for the Democratic party is present in other states. Furthermore, in states with more-impactful CSLs, changes in CSLs and their associated increased educational attainment explain almost all of the diverging support for political parties and differences in opinion over major policy issues by sex, such as gun control and abortion. Altogether, these new facts present an original explanation that relies upon the effect of education to explain the evolution of gender political preferences in the U.S. over the last 40 years.
36015.zh_abstract: 过去40年美国选举政治最显著的发展之一是男性和女性选民之间日益扩大的分歧。1980年，男性和女性对民主党和共和党的支持水平大致相当，而更近期的调查显示，女性相对于男性对民主党的偏好存在约10至15个百分点的差距。我们通过使用多种计量经济学策略，建立义务教育法（CSLs）、教育 attainment 与按性别分化的政治偏好之间的新颖联系，来解释这一结果。首先，我们表明这一分歧的时间与近期CSLs的变化相吻合，并且这一分歧几乎完全归因于在CSLs对平均教育 attainment 影响强得多的州中，对民主党偏好的性别相关变化——在其他州，对民主党的性别相关偏好几乎没有变化。此外，在CSLs影响更大的州，CSLs的变化及其相关的教育 attainment 提高几乎解释了按性别分化的政党支持以及枪支管制和堕胎等重大政策议题意见差异的全部。总之，这些新事实提出了一个依赖教育效应来解释过去40年美国性别政治偏好演变的原创性解释。

36014.title: The Labor Market Impact of Temporary High-Skill Immigration Programs
36014.zh_title: 临时高技能移民项目的劳动力市场影响
36014.zh_abstract_excerpt: 2019年，约120万外国工人通过临时高技能项目就业，包括H-1B和OPT。本文在美国社区调查中识别可能的临时工人，并按教育程度和学位领域衡量其供给。暴露程度最高的技能组中的本土人经历了更慢的收入增长和全职全年工作的相对下降。许多临时工人在身份结束后留下，但调查无法识别这些留下者。一个关于临时流入和留下者的模型表明，在特定条件下，将本土结果对当前临时工人数量进行IV回归所得的系数体现了一个留下者乘数，捕捉了这些工人和更早留下者的效应。
36014.abstract: In 2019, about 1.2 million foreign workers were employed through temporary high-skill programs, including H-1B and OPT. This paper identifies likely temporary workers in the American Community Survey and measures their supply by education and field of degree. Natives in the most exposed skill groups experienced slower earnings growth and a relative decline in full-time year-round work. Many temporary workers stay after their status ends, but surveys cannot identify these stayers. A model of temporary inflows and stayers shows that, under specified conditions, the coefficient from an IV regression of native outcomes on the number of current temporary workers embodies a stayer multiplier, capturing the effects of both those workers and earlier stayers. Multiplying the coefficient by the observed increase in temporary workers recovers the programs’ full effect without data on stayers. The estimates imply that natives with science and engineering degrees earn about 3.5 percent less, and those with master’s degrees in computing or electrical and computer engineering about 16 percent less. Production complementarities raise average wages by about 1.4 percent, offsetting only part of those losses. Absent externalities, the programs mainly redistribute earnings.

36013.title: Irregular Demand: The Anti-Compromise Effect in the Field
36013.zh_title: 不规则需求：实地中的反妥协效应
36013.authors: Nicola Gennaioli, John A. List, Matthias Rodemeier, Gregory K. Sun
36013.zh_abstract_excerpt: 新古典需求遵循正则性：增加一种商品只能将需求从现有商品上引开。在一项覆盖720万乘客和4700万次选择的Lyft自然实地实验中，我们随机化高端乘车的存在和价格。与正则性相反，高端乘车提高了对最便宜现有选项和不购买的需求。该效应随高端价格和重复暴露而增大，并在未展示高端乘车的会话中持续存在。理性推断和注意力不足无法解释这些事实。一个模型可以解释这些现象：令人意外的高价格在应用上被提示并从记忆中提取，从而将注意力引向价格。
36013.abstract: Neoclassical demand obeys regularity: adding a good can only draw demand away from existing goods. In a natural field experiment with Lyft covering 7.2 million riders and 47 million choices, we randomize the presence and price of a premium ride. Contrary to regularity, the premium ride raises demand for the cheapest incumbent and for not buying. The effect grows with the premium price and with repeated exposure, and persists in sessions where the premium ride is not displayed. Rational inference and inattention cannot account for these facts. A model in which a surprisingly high price, cued on the app and retrieved from memory, draws attention to prices explains them.

36012.title: Last-Mile Delivery and the Future of Aid
36012.zh_title: 最后一公里交付与援助的未来
36012.authors: Erika Deserranno, Andrea Guariso, Nancy Qian
36012.zh_abstract_excerpt: 对外援助旨在为贫困和脆弱人群提供医疗和教育等基本服务。其有效性取决于最后一公里交付：这些服务能否到达需要它们的人手中。本文回顾了关于最后一公里交付两个关键方面的证据。第一个方面涉及非国家提供者（尤其是非政府组织）日益增长的作用，及其对国家提供服务和协调各提供者能力的影响。第二个方面涉及直接向受益人提供服务的一线工作人员的选择、激励和管理。
36012.abstract: Foreign aid seeks to provide basic services, such as health care and education, to poor and vulnerable populations. Its effectiveness depends on last-mile delivery: whether those services reach the people who need them. This article reviews evidence on two key aspects of last-mile delivery. The first concerns the growing role of non-state providers, especially NGOs, and its implication for state’s capacity to deliver services and coordinate across providers. The second concerns the selection, motivation, and management of frontline workers who provide the services directly to beneficiaries. We argue that decisions about aid allocation and withdrawal should account for the but can quickly erode. need to preserve last-mile delivery capacity, which takes time and resources to build.

36011.title: Investment and Governance: Through The Lens of Sustainability
36011.zh_title: 投资与治理：可持续性视角
36011.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们使用2013年至2022年间上市公司发行的3,944笔可持续债券，考察可持续投资对治理采纳的因果效应。基于异方差性的识别策略显示，可持续债务（占总债务）每增加1%，采纳可持续治理的可能性提高9.2%。这种采纳使环境绩效提高16%（结构估计）。这些效应仅限于非金融企业；对于金融企业，仅采纳治理是不够的，因为可持续贷款借款人的环境绩效并未改善。环境绩效较强的企业更不可能采纳可持续治理。结果在替代定义和大量设定检验下保持稳健。
36011.abstract: Using 3,944 sustainable bond issuances by public firms from 2013 to 2022, we examine the causal effect of sustainable investment on governance adoption. A heteroskedasticity-based identification strategy reveals that a 1% increase in sustainable debt (by total debt) raises the likelihood of sustainable governance adoption by 9.2%. Such adoption improves environmental performance by 16% (structural estimates). These effects are confined to non-financial firms; for financial firms, governance adoption alone is in-sufficient, as sustainable loan borrowers environmental performance does not improve. Firms with stronger environmental performance are less likely to adopt sustainable governance. Results are robust to alternative definitions and extensive specification checks.

36010.title: Gambling for Goals
36010.authors: Costas Arkolakis, Spencer Y. Kwon, Dominic Russel, Claire Shi, Hyunjoo Yang
36010.zh_abstract_excerpt: 近年来，发达经济体的年轻人对其经济前景变得更加悲观。与此同时，类似赌博的金融活动激增。我们通过Friedman-Savage（1948）动机将这两种趋势联系起来：当购房或结婚等人生目标似乎遥不可及时，个人会转向金融赌博。我们使用一项原创调查，并结合来自韩国领先征信机构、电信提供商和信用卡发行商的数百万条关联记录来检验这一理论。与该理论一致，更重视难以实现目标的个人承担更多风险，而且他们承担风险的形式随其与这些目标的距离而系统性变化。
36010.abstract: Young adults in advanced economies have grown more pessimistic about their economic prospects in recent years. At the same time, gambling-like financial activities have proliferated. We link these trends through a Friedman-Savage (1948) motive: when life goals such as homeownership or marriage seem out of reach, individuals turn to financial gambles. We test this theory using an original survey combined with millions of linked records from Korea’s leading credit bureau, telecom provider, and credit card issuer. Consistent with the theory, individuals who place greater importance on hard-to-reach goals take more risk, and the form of risk they take varies systematically with their distance from those goals. Within individuals, cryptocurrency app usage rises during unemployment and falls after winning the right to purchase price-regulated housing through a lottery. A calibration shows how hard-to-reach goals lead households to act more aggressively on their beliefs, amplifying the consequences of overoptimism.

36009.title: Measuring the Impact of Impact Measurement

36009.authors: Emanuele Colonnelli, Timothy McQuade, Natalia Rigol, Benjamin N. Roth
36009.zh_abstract_excerpt: 影响力测量是影响力投资和社会创业的核心，但鲜有人知企业是否能从测量影响力中获得私人收益。我们在印度高成长社会企业中开展了首个影响力测量干预的随机对照试验。处理组企业的收入增长几乎是对照组的两倍，筹集的资本也几乎是对照组的两倍。在一项针对早期阶段投资者的配套实验中，我们发现投资者对量化的影响力指标反应强烈，但对笼统的定性影响力陈述没有反应。总之，我们的结果表明，影响力测量可以塑造企业增长和资本配置。

Treated firms exhibit nearly twice as much revenue growth and raise nearly twice as much capital as control firms. In a companion experiment with early-stage investors, we find that investors respond strongly to quantified impact metrics but not to generic qualitative impact statements. Together, our results show that impact measurement can shape firm growth and capital allocation.

36008.title: Monetary policy in a Phelps–Winter Economy
36008.authors: Bruce C. Greenwald, Joseph E. Stiglitz
36008.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们使用Phelps-Winter客户市场——它为经济中很大一部分提供了比标准模型更好的价格决定理论——表明提高利率会引发更高价格，因为企业更看重当前利润，并更愿意为短期收益而失去客户。这些通胀效应在相关利率区间内可能很显著；即使加息成功削减总需求，它们在短期内也存在；而且它们会被政策不确定性以及利率变化影响的不确定性放大，而随着常规政策在将通胀保持在2%目标方面明显严重失败，这两种不确定性都已上升。
36008.abstract: We use the Phelps-Winter customer market—providing a better theory of price determination for large parts of the economy than the standard model—to show that raising interest rates induces higher prices, as firms value current profits more, and are more willing to lose customers for short-term gains. These inflationary effects can be significant in relevant ranges of interest rates; they exist in the short run even when interest rate hikes succeed in cutting aggregate demand; and that they are amplified by policy uncertainty and the uncertainty about the effects of interest rate changes, both of which have increased as conventional policy has demonstrably failed badly to keep inflation at the 2% target. Empirical studies confirm this low level of ineffectiveness of raising interest rates in reducing inflation. The weakening effectiveness of monetary policy was predicted by our earlier work on banks and the supply of credit, as a result of the elimination of interest prohibition on deposits; and further suggested by work on the structural transformation of the economy, as customer markets become more important.

36007.title: Horizontal Equity of Taxation: Citizen Beliefs and Policy Preferences

36007.authors: Pierre Bachas, Christopher A. Hoy, Anders Jensen, Mahvish Shaukat
36007.zh_abstract_excerpt: 对自雇者征税比工薪收入者更难，从而在收入相近的纳税人之间造成横向不平等。我们使用来自29个发展中国家的税收微观模拟和家庭调查数据表明，实际税制中的横向不平等在量级上与纵向公平相当，并且会因累进改革而加剧，因为这些改革不成比例地落在工薪收入者身上。随后我们在巴基斯坦开展调查和随机信息实验，研究公众对这些不平等的看法。尽管提供信息提高了公平关切，但并未增加对减少不平等的改革的支持，这揭示了改善税收公平的一个重要政治约束。
36007.abstract: Taxes are harder to enforce on the self-employed than on wage earners, creating horizontal inequities among taxpayers with similar incomes. Using tax microsimulation and household survey data from 29 developing countries, we show that horizontal inequities in actual tax systems are comparable in magnitude to vertical equity and are exacerbated by progressive reforms that fall disproportionately on wage earners. We then conduct surveys and randomized information experiments in Pakistan to study public perceptions of these inequities. Although providing information raises fairness concerns, it does not increase support for reforms reducing it, revealing an important political constraint to improving tax equity.

36006.title: How Will the 340B Rebate Model Pilot Affect Covered Entity Finances?
36006.zh_title: 340B返利模式试点将如何影响覆盖实体的财务状况？
36006.zh_abstract_excerpt: 美国卫生资源与服务管理局（HRSA）计划实施一项试点，将针对《医疗保险药品价格谈判计划》（MDPNP）内药品的340B从预先折扣模式转为返利模式。本研究采用校准方法预测返利模式试点（RMP）对覆盖实体从340B计划获得的净收入的影响。我考察了以下方面可能造成的损失：被避免的重复折扣；有效索赔被拒；制造商利用数据施加影响；与流动性相关的费用；以及行政和人员成本。我还预测了将整个340B计划转为返利模式的影响。
36006.abstract: The Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) plans to implement a pilot switching 340B from an upfront discount model to a rebate model for drugs in the Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program (MDPNP). This study uses calibration methods to predict the impact of the rebate model pilot (RMP) on covered entities’ net revenues from the 340B program. I examine possible losses from averted duplicate discounts; denial of valid claims; manufacturers using data to exert influence; liquidity-related expenses; and administrative and staffing costs. I also project the effects of switching the entire 340B program to a rebate model. I project net revenue losses from the RMP of $1.5 billion. Expansion to all of 340B would increase the predicted losses to $22.8 billion, cutting net revenues from the program by 32%. The majority of losses will come from administrative and staffing costs, which do not benefit manufacturers, implying a net negative effect of switching to a rebate model. Covered entity losses from the RMP will be limited by the pilot only applying to a small percentage of 340B sales as well as restrictions HRSA’s guidance places on manufacturers. If the rebate model expands to all of 340B or if the restrictions are inadequately enforced, the losses will grow substantially.

36060.zh_title: 光污染：对睡眠、工作与心理健康的影响
36060.authors: Joan Costa-i-Font, Janet Currie, Soodeh Saberian
36060.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本研究考察人工路灯对睡眠的影响，以及对心理健康、缺勤和身体活动的下游效应。我们利用加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省本拿比市将传统钠灯路灯替换为发光二极管（LED）灯所产生的外生变异。使用加拿大社区健康调查数据，我们考察与未采用新照明的温哥华市交界处的入睡困难断点。我们还估计了一个利用LED灯在各社区推广的本拿比市内模型，以及一个使用匹配的温哥华和本拿比社区的双重差分设计。
36060.abstract: This study examines the impact of artificial streetlights on sleep, as well as downstream effects on mental health, absenteeism, and physical activity. We exploit variation resulting from the replacement of traditional sodium streetlights with light-emitting diode (LED) lights in Burnaby, British Columbia, Canada. Using data from the Canadian Community Health Survey, we examine discontinuities in difficulty sleeping at the municipal border with Vancouver, which did not adopt new lighting. We also estimate a within-Burnaby model exploiting the rollout of LED lights across neighborhoods, and a difference-in-differences design using matched Vancouver and Burnaby neighborhoods. The estimates show that conversion reduces difficulty sleeping immediately, and that improvements in mental health, absenteeism, and physical activity follow with a lag of two to three years. The largest gains occur with warmer-toned LEDs that more closely mimic natural light.

36059.title: Supply-Side Drivers of Long-Acting Reversible Contraceptives: Evidence from Medicaid Beneficiaries
36059.zh_title: 长效可逆避孕药具的供给侧驱动因素：来自医疗补助受益人的证据
36059.authors: Maya Rossin-Slater, Natalia Serna, Lin-Tung Tsai
36059.zh_abstract_excerpt: 美国联邦法律规定大多数保险公司必须向患者免费提供避孕药具，但近三分之一育龄妇女仍报告避孕服务获取不足。在需求侧可负担性障碍基本消除的情况下，供给侧因素——医疗机构和提供者的行为——可能是解释这一未满足需求的关键。本文考察医疗补助受益人中长效可逆避孕药具（LARC）使用的供给侧决定因素，该人群的LARC和口服避孕药（OC）均以零自付费用覆盖。与OC不同，LARC需要临床医生置入和预先设备储备，使其特别容易受到供给侧力量的影响。
36059.abstract: U.S. federal law mandates that most insurers offer contraceptives for free to patients, yet nearly one in three women of reproductive age still report inadequate access to contraceptive services. With demand-side affordability barriers largely removed, supply-side factors—the actions of healthcare facilities and providers—may be critical in explaining this unmet need. This paper examines supply-side determinants of long-acting reversible contraceptive (LARC) use among Medicaid beneficiaries, a population for whom both LARCs and oral contraceptives (OCs) are covered at zero out-of-pocket cost. Unlike OCs, LARCs require clinician insertion and upfront device stocking, making them especially vulnerable to supply-side forces. Using national Medicaid claims data from 2015–2019 and a movers design that separates place-based from patient-based variation, we find that local supply-side factors explain 58.5 percent of geographic variation in LARC use—substantially more than the 37.7 percent explained for OCs. We then estimate the causal effects of a supply-side policy that substantially lowers the cost of stocking LARCs for safety-net providers: the 340B Drug Pricing Program. Leveraging the staggered timing of program participation across clinics in an event-study design, we find that the arrival of the first participating clinic in an enrollee's ZIP code increases LARC use by 4.3 percent without displacing OC use or increasing LARC removals. Together, these findings identify the supply side as both a key source of unmet contraceptive need and a promising target for policy to improve access to the most effective forms of contraception.

36058.title: Beyond the First Best: Welfare and OPEC Market Power

36058.authors: John Asker, Allan Collard-Wexler, Charlotte De Cannière, Jan De Loecker
36058.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们引入一个实证框架，通过卡特尔协调生产决策来量化市场势力的福利影响，同时允许其他扭曲存在。我们将两个新概念——边际福利损失和超边际福利损失——与未能认识到市场势力之外其他扭曲存在的朴素方法进行对比。我们将该框架应用于衡量OPEC在全球原油市场中的市场势力影响。我们利用关于成本和生产的独特微观数据来量化OPEC卡特尔导致的无谓损失和生产无效率。自1970年以来，朴素方法意味着OPEC造成了2.
36058.abstract: We introduce an empirical framework to quantify the welfare impact of market power, through coordinated production decisions by a cartel, while allowing for other distortions. We contrast two novel concepts – the marginal and the infra-marginal welfare loss – to a naive approach that fails to recognize the existence of other distortions operating alongside market power. We apply the framework to measure the impact of market power of OPEC in the global crude oil market. We leverage unique micro data on cost and production to quantify the deadweight loss and productive inefficiency due to the OPEC cartel. From 1970 onward, the naive approach implies that OPEC generated 2.2 trillion dollars of welfare losses, two-thirds from productive inefficiency and one-third from deadweight loss. Eliminating cost-minimization violations outside the cartel shrinks losses to around 0.7 trillion dollars, indicating that other frictions in the oil market are complementary to OPEC’s market power.

36057.title: CFOs Meet LLMs
36057.authors: John R. Graham, Campbell R. Harvey, Manish Jha
36057.zh_abstract_excerpt: 商业情绪受到密切关注，但测量缓慢且成本高昂：调查仅覆盖有限数量的企业，定期进行，且需要时间实地开展和汇总。我们表明大型语言模型有潜力解决其中一些不足。对于2002—2025年期间回应杜克—美联储CFO调查的每一位上市公司CFO，我们提示大型语言模型在特定日期角色扮演特定公司的CFO。我们发现大型语言模型生成的预测与CFO预期的横截面合理匹配，准确性随着提供给大型语言模型的信息量增加而提高。
36057.abstract: Business sentiment is closely watched, but measurement is slow and costly: surveys reach a limited number of firms, arrive periodically, and take time to field and compile. We show that large language models hold the potential to address some of these shortcomings. We prompt an LLM to role-play as the CFO of a specific company on a specific date, for every public-company CFO who responded to the Duke–Federal Reserve CFO Survey from 2002- 2025. We find that LLM-generated forecasts reasonably match the cross-section of CFO expectations, with accuracy increasing with the amount of information provided to the LLM. We discuss the potential as well as the hurdles to using digital twins to mimic individual decision-makers.

36056.title: Chips & Tokens at the Fault Lines: Two Stacks in One Fragmenting World
36056.zh_title: 断层线上的芯片与代币：一个碎片化世界中的两个技术栈
36056.zh_abstract_excerpt: 美国和中国都已建立起对彼此造成严重经济损害的能力。本文认为，由此产生的相互脆弱性现在约束着双方，并阻止进一步的经济脱钩。本文在两个技术栈上描绘这场竞争：计算、半导体和稀土构成的实体经济栈，以及美元主导地位和数字金融构成的金融栈。在实体方面，通过大型语言模型对全球财报电话会议报告的分析表明，这种相互脆弱性在2025年已经在塑造全球企业叙事。在金融方面，本文认为数字金融可能使这一平衡向任一方向倾斜。
36056.abstract: The United States and China have each built the capacity to inflict serious economic damage on each other. This paper argues that the resulting mutual vulnerability now constrains both sides and prevents further economic decoupling. The paper maps this contest across two stacks: the real economy stack of computing, semiconductors and rare earths, and the financial stack of dollar dominance and digital finance. On the real side, an analysis of global earnings call reports, run through large language models, suggests that this mutual vulnerability was already shaping the global corporate narrative in 2025. On the financial side, the paper argues that digital finance could tip this balance either way. Portable U.S. dollar-denominated digital assets could deepen U.S. dollar dominance and erode China's capital controls, tilting the balance toward Washington and inviting more fragmentation. A drift of transactions onto offshore rails like Tether could do the opposite, eroding Washington’s enforcement power behind sanctions and, counterintuitively, restraining it. Both the U.S. and China, meanwhile, run internally inconsistent policies. The U.S. is closing its door to trade while keeping an open financial account, and China is doing the reverse. These configurations are ultimately unsustainable and could undermine the arsenals that sustain the equilibrium.

36055.abstract: Democrats and Republicans express some sharply different views about tax policy, but whether these ideological divisions translate into partisan differences in taxpayer behavior is far less clear. We study this question in the context of a common form of tax avoidance: property tax appeals. In a survey, we find that Americans, on average, believe Republican homeowners are more likely to appeal their property taxes than Democratic homeowners with similarly valued homes. Yet linking administrative property tax records from Dallas County with voting records reveals that this stereotype is not borne out in practice: the partisan gap in appeals is small, both in absolute terms (0.29 percentage points) and relative to several demographic gaps in appeals we use as benchmarks. Similar appeal rates could nonetheless conceal differences in motives. Using quasi-experimental and field experimental evidence, we find that Democrats and Republicans appeal for broadly similar reasons. In sum, despite differing tax policy preferences and public perceptions about their behavior, Democrats and Republicans are strikingly similar in both their propensity to appeal their property taxes and their underlying motives.

36054.title: Mortality Effects of the 2025 US Aid Freeze: Evidence from Zambia
36054.zh_title: 2025年美国援助冻结的死亡率效应：来自赞比亚的证据
36054.authors: Torsten Figueiredo Walter, Dean Karlan, Niclas Moneke, Ana Radu, Khozya Zyambo
36054.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究2025年美国对外援助突然冻结及随后解冻对HIV预防、治疗、感染和死亡的影响。在赞比亚，HIV相关援助通过两个机构实施。其中一个机构的活动被中断了数月，而另一个机构的活动受影响小得多。来自赞比亚所有卫生机构的综合数据显示，预防性HIV措施立即出现差异性减少，随后大多恢复，接着出现更多HIV阳性孕妇、更多HIV暴露新生儿、更多机会性感染和更多记录死亡。
36054.abstract: We study the impact of the 2025 sudden freeze then subsequent thaw of US foreign aid on HIV prevention, treatment, infection, and death. In Zambia, HIV-related aid was administered through two agencies. Activities under one were disrupted for several months, and those under the other much less. Comprehensive data from all Zambian health facilities reveal immediate differential reductions in preventive HIV measures that mostly later recovered, followed by more HIV-positive pregnant women, more HIV-exposed births, more opportunistic infections, and more recorded deaths. For example, after one year we observe a 14% [95% CI: 3, 25] increase in HIV-positive pregnant women and a 26% [95% CI: 8, 45] increase in deaths among people living with HIV who were receiving antiretroviral therapy.

36053.title: Shrink Responsibly: Empirical Bayes in Economics
36053.zh_title: 负责任地收缩：经济学中的经验贝叶斯方法
36053.zh_abstract_excerpt: 实证研究者常关注个体或机构（如教师、学校、医院或社区）的相对因果影响。基于回归的此类单位特定参数估计往往噪声较大；经验贝叶斯（eB）方法有助于从估计噪声中分离信号。本文概述eB方法，展示即使推动收缩的工作模型设定有误，eB收缩也能改善复合决策——例如选择因果影响最高的个体。然而，并非所有分析都能从eB收缩中受益；我们讨论哪些类型的因果汇总最适合直接估计，以及如何稳健地做到这一点。我们通过对公立中小学增值的连续分析来说明实际要点。
36053.abstract: Empirical researchers are often interested in the relative causal impact of individuals or institutions such as teachers, schools, hospitals, or neighborhoods. Regression-based estimates of such unit-specific parameters are often noisy; empirical Bayes (eB) methods can help isolate the signal from the estimation noise. This article provides an overview of eB methodology, showing how eB shrinkage can improve compound decisions—such as selecting individuals with the highest causal impacts—even when the working model motivating the shrinkage is misspecified. Not all analyses benefit from eB shrinkage, however, and we discuss which types of causal summaries are best estimated directly and how to do so robustly. We illustrate practical takeaways with a running analysis of public elementary and middle school value-added.

36052.title: Long-run Uncovered Interest Parity in Emerging Markets
36052.zh_title: 新兴市场的长期非抛补利率平价
36052.authors: Alessandro Rebucci, Sinem Yagmur Toraman, Giorgio Valente, Nicolò Capirone
36052.zh_abstract_excerpt: 非抛补利率平价（UIP）在发达经济体货币的长期期限上往往成立。其在新兴市场是否成立仍是一个更开放的问题。我们表明它并不成立，并指出主权信用风险可以解释这一失败。使用2000年至2025年所有可获得数据的新兴市场货币的月度零息本币收益率曲线，我们发现新兴市场货币在五年期限上长期UIP回归的斜率远低于1，而G10货币则不能拒绝斜率为1。然而，当我们在这些回归中加入主权CDS利差后，对于浮动新兴市场货币，该斜率上升至与1在统计上无法区分的值。
36052.abstract: Uncovered interest parity (UIP) tends to hold at long horizons for advanced-economy currencies. Whether it holds in emerging markets remains a more open question. We show it does not, and that sovereign credit risk can explain the failure. Using monthly zero-coupon local-currency yield curves for all emerging market currencies for which they are available from 2000 to 2025, we find that the slope of long-horizon UIP regressions is well below one at the five-year maturity for emerging market currencies, while unity cannot be rejected for G10 currencies. However, when we augment these regressions with sovereign CDS spreads, this slope rises to values statistically indistinguishable from one for floating emerging market currencies. The correction works best for currencies whose credit risk is most variable. A no-arbitrage asset pricing framework guides the specification of the regressions and the interpretation of the results.

36051.title: Climate Risk, Real Estate, and Property Insurance
36051.zh_title: 气候风险、房地产和财产保险
36051.authors: Benjamin L. Collier, Benjamin J. Keys, Philip Mulder
36051.zh_abstract_excerpt: 日益增长的气候风险威胁着房地产等长期固定实物资产。为应对这一风险，房主和潜在买家依赖市场信号，包括房产价值和保险成本。这些市场信号的有效性取决于标准经济学假设是否成立。在本综述中，我们评估住房和保险市场是否准确反映气候风险，以及市场参与者是否接收并响应这些信号。快速增长的文献记录了从气候风险到价格这一链条每个环节中的重大摩擦，并对适应和恢复产生下游后果。
36051.abstract: Growing climate risk threatens long-lived, fixed physical assets like real estate. To navigate this risk, homeowners and prospective buyers rely on market signals, including property values and insurance costs. The effectiveness of these market signals depends on whether standard economic assumptions hold. In this review, we assess whether housing and insurance markets accurately reflect climate risk, and whether market participants receive and respond to those signals. A rapidly growing literature documents substantial frictions in each part of the chain from climate risk to prices, with downstream consequences for adaptation and recovery. We conclude that these frictions call into question whether the price signals provided by real estate and insurance markets are likely to steer households into outcomes that are resilient to growing climate risk.

36050.title: Past Automation and Future AI: How Weak Links Tame the Growth Explosion
36050.zh_title: 过去的自动化与未来的AI：弱环节如何抑制增长爆炸
36050.zh_abstract_excerpt: 过去增长中有多少归因于自动化，这对AI的未来意味着什么？我们进行基于任务的增长核算，并表明在美国经济中，资本任务生产率比劳动任务生产率每年快约5个百分点。自动化的主要好处是在更多任务上使用快速改进的机器而非缓慢改进的人类。利用这些历史度量，我们校准了一个商品和思想生产内生自动化的增长模型。增长加速并可能爆炸。然而，加速被“弱环节”——仍由劳动执行的任务——所减缓。
36050.abstract: How much past growth is due to automation, and what does this imply for the future of AI? We perform task-based growth accounting and show that capital task productivity has grown about 5 percentage points per year faster than labor task productivity in the U.S. economy. The main benefit of automation is using rapidly improving machines instead of slowly-improving humans on more tasks. With these historical measures, we calibrate a growth model in which the production of goods and ideas is endogenously automated. Growth accelerates and can explode. However, the acceleration is slowed by "weak links," tasks still performed by labor.

36049.title: Bureaucratic Rigidity and Battle Outcomes: Evidence from Military Logistics in the Ming Dynasty
36049.zh_title: 官僚刚性与战斗结果：来自明代军事后勤的证据
36049.authors: Jingjing Chen, Jianlei Han, Shing-Yi Wang, Yongxiang Wang
36049.zh_abstract_excerpt: 旨在提高问责的官僚规则可能削弱国家效能。我们研究1492年明朝的一项改革，该改革将军事粮食运送从盐商转向国家接力系统，实行府到府的交接和固定路线。此后，宫廷记录显示，原由商人供应的卫所比国家供应的卫所出现更多供应短缺。利用406场抵御外敌入侵的防御战，我们发现该改革降低了这些卫所附近的胜率。下降在补给最重要（更长战争、城墙防御）以及国家规则成本最高（路线跨越更多府或易受洪水、干旱或崎岖地形影响）的地方最大。
36049.abstract: Bureaucratic rules meant to improve accountability can undermine state effectiveness. We study a 1492 Ming dynasty reform that shifted military grain delivery from salt merchants to a state relay system with prefecture-to-prefecture handovers and fixed routes. Afterward, court records document more supply shortages at formerly merchant-supplied garrisons than at state-supplied ones. Using 406 defensive battles against foreign invaders, we find the reform reduced victory rates near these garrisons. Declines were largest where resupply mattered most (longer wars, walled-city defenses) and where the state’s rules were most costly (routes crossing more prefectures or exposed to floods, droughts, or rugged terrain).

36048.title: Are Revealed Preferences All You Need for AI Alignment?
36048.zh_title: 显示性偏好足以实现AI对齐吗？
36048.authors: Joshua S. Gans, Richard T. Holden
36048.zh_abstract_excerpt: AI代理从委托人的选择中学习委托人想要什么。我们提出了一个标准，用以判断在AI可能持有的每一种信念下，委托人的决策是否就是AI所需的全部信息。就行动而言，确实如此。谨慎的行动（例如听从某个人）通常会将委托人的行动划分为若干区块；而对于选择无成本证据而言，当同一证据在每个区块中都是最优时，决策才恰好足够。否则，AI会像其委托人那样行动，却可能收集到错误的证据，而更强的能力会将这一错误转化为不正确的行动。
36048.abstract: AI agents learn what principals want from what principals choose. We offer a criterion for when a principal's decisions, at every belief an AI might hold, are all the AI needs. For acting, they are. Cautious actions, such as deferring to a person, typically divide the principal's actions into blocks, and for choosing costless evidence, decisions are enough exactly when the same evidence is best in every block. Otherwise, the AI acts as its principal would yet can gather the wrong evidence, and greater capability can turn that error into incorrect actions. Choices between two mistakes reveal what decisions miss.

36047.title: Regret, Survival Beliefs, and Retirement Recommendations
36047.zh_title: 后悔、生存信念与退休建议
36047.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们考察关于他人退休后悔的信息如何影响年金化建议和储蓄建议。在一项调查实验中，参与者收到了关于未购买年金或未为退休储蓄足够资金的后悔信息。反应集中在那些相对于人口基准低估自身生存概率的个体中，这与生存信念更新机制相一致。在低估者中，年金后悔信息使年金化建议提高了16.9个百分点（约38%），而储蓄后悔信息使显著增加储蓄的建议降低了15.4个百分点（约28%）。
36047.abstract: We examine how information about others’ retirement regret affects annuitization and savings recommendations. In a survey experiment, participants received information about regret over not purchasing annuities or not saving enough for retirement. Responses were concentrated among individuals who underestimated their survival probabilities relative to population benchmarks, consistent with a survival belief-updating mechanism. Among underestimators, annuity regret information increased annuitization recommendations by 16.9 percentage points (approximately 38%), while savings regret information reduced recommendations to significantly increase saving by 15.4 percentage points (approximately 28%). Less regret-averse individuals reduced aggressive savings recommendations, while the positive response to annuity regret information was concentrated among more risk-averse respondents. The annuity effect was strongest among respondents with greater annuity knowledge than less knowledgeable respondents.

36046.title: Valuing the Cost of Incomplete Global Markets
36046.zh_title: 评估全球市场不完全的成本
36046.authors: Karen K. Lewis, Edith X. Liu
36046.zh_abstract_excerpt: 跨境投资中偏离完全金融市场的现象会产生经济福利成本。本文基于三个主要结果，展示了如何利用标准理论和数据来评估这些成本。我们的第一个结果展示了如何从一般的财富-股息比率推导出福利估值。接下来，我们确立了如何利用总消费和汇率数据来揭示各国之间可分散的商品配置。最后，我们展示了如何利用资产定价数据和模型来评估对完全市场的偏离。本文概述了属于该框架的一系列应用，包括金融中介约束模型。
36046.abstract: Deviations from complete financial markets in cross-border investments generate economic welfare costs. This paper shows how to value these costs using standard theory and data based on three main results. Our first result shows how welfare valuations can be derived from a general wealth-to-dividend ratio. Next, we establish how aggregate consumption and exchange rate data can be used to uncover diversifiable goods allocations across countries. Finally, we demonstrate how asset pricing data and models can be used to value deviations from complete markets. The paper outlines a range of applications that fall under this framework, including financial intermediary constraint models.

36045.title: How AI Impacts the Quest for Knowledge: Evidence from AlphaFold2
36045.zh_title: AI如何影响知识探索：来自AlphaFold2的证据
36045.zh_abstract_excerpt: 科学家可以通过推进科学前沿并提出新问题来回应人工智能，也可以通过加深对已有研究问题的理解来回应。我们研究AI如何在结构生物学中塑造这一选择，在该领域中实验检验蛋白质的三维结构及其功能。AlphaFold2于2021年发布，可预测几乎所有已知蛋白质的结构，其置信度因蛋白质而异。我们将530,471种蛋白质与2017年至2025年间对其进行的实验相关联，比较2021年之后预测置信度较高和较低的蛋白质在实验活动上的变化。
36045.abstract: Scientists can respond to artificial intelligence by pushing the frontier of science and asking new questions, or by deepening their understanding of questions already studied. We study how AI shapes this choice in structural biology, where experiments examine a protein's three-dimensional structure and its function. AlphaFold2, released in 2021, predicts the structure of almost every known protein, with a confidence that varies across proteins. Linking 530,471 proteins to the experiments run on them between 2017 and 2025, we compare how experimental activity changed after 2021 across proteins with more and less confident predictions. Where predictions are more confident, the experimental record adds fewer first structures for proteins far from any relative of known structure. It adds more follow-up experiments on proteins whose structure is already known, and the rise is largest for proteins surrounded by relatives of known structure. A model of experimental choice shows how AlphaFold2 can deepen existing knowledge rather than extend it: a prediction replaces an experiment that would establish a protein's structure, and it lowers the cost of experiments that build on that structure.

36044.title: Beyond Publication Bias: Characterizing and Understanding Missing Results in Economics
36044.zh_title: 超越发表偏倚：刻画和理解经济学中缺失的结果
36044.authors: Fernando Hoces de la Guardia, Edward Miguel, Gufran Pathan, Akash Shaji, Viviane Helena Silva da Rocha, Erik Ø. Sørensen, Bertil Tungodden
36044.zh_abstract_excerpt: 科学家选择不发表的内容可能与他們发表的内容同样重要。我们在假设层面衡量缺失的研究结果，并利用这一方法研究经济学中的报告不足问题。在2015年至2017年间在美国经济学会RCT注册中心注册的317项研究的5,057个预注册假设中，只有42%在预注册后八到九年有公开可用的结果。在可用的结果中，64%为零结果，我们几乎没有发现零结果被不成比例地缺失的证据。在一项RCT中，与作者直接接触使有可用结果的假设比例提高了6.
36044.abstract: What scientists choose not to publish can be as important as what they do publish. We measure missing research results at the hypothesis level and use this approach to study under-reporting in economics. Across 5,057 pre-registered hypotheses from 317 studies registered on the American Economic Association RCT Registry between 2015 and 2017, only 42% have publicly available results eight to nine years after pre-registration. Among the available results, 64% are null, and we find little evidence that null results are disproportionately missing. In an RCT, direct engagement with authors increases the share of hypotheses with available results by 6.2 percentage points, while raising awareness alone has no significant effect and additional research assistance provides no further improvement. Direct engagement also increases explanations for unavailable results, reducing the share of hypotheses that remain unaccounted for by 16.4 percentage points. The findings document extensive under-reporting in economics that does not appear to be driven primarily by the suppression of null results, and suggest that reporting pre-registered results may need to become a standard part of the research process rather than something recovered years later.

36043.title: Mental Models of Fiscal Policy
36043.authors: Francesco Bianchi, Era Dabla-Norris, Radhika Goyal, Victoria Haver, Salma Khalid
36043.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究个体如何形成对财政调整的预期。利用来自13个国家超过27,000名受访者的调查数据，我们联合 elicits 对当前财政状况的信念、对增税和削减支出的预期，以及对这些预期的开放式解释。我们将这些解释分类为经济心理模型、政治叙事和基于经验的启发式。报告相似财政状况的受访者 nevertheless 形成了系统不同的调整预期。在我们考察的财政配置中，经济心理模型与更强的增税和削减支出预期相关联，而基于经验的推理与较弱的调整预期相关联。
36043.abstract: We study how individuals form expectations about fiscal adjustment. Using survey data from more than 27,000 respondents across 13 countries, we jointly elicit beliefs about current fiscal conditions, expectations of tax increases and spending cuts, and open-ended explanations for those expectations. We classify these explanations into economic mental models, political narratives, and experience-based heuristics. Respondents reporting similar fiscal conditions nevertheless form systematically different expectations of adjustment. Economic mental models are associated with stronger expectations of tax increases and spending cuts in the fiscal configurations we examine, whereas experience-based reasoning is associated with weaker adjustment expectations. These differences are also reflected in intended economic behavior and portfolio allocations. In a randomized experiment, fiscal information increases the likelihood that respondents articulate economic reasoning, primarily among responses that would otherwise fall outside the three primary frameworks.
