36042.title: The Effects of Private Plan Subsidies on Enrollment: Evidence from Medicare Advantage
36042.zh_title: 私人计划补贴对参保的影响：来自Medicare Advantage的证据
36042.authors: Paul D. Jacobs, Timothy J. Layton
36042.zh_abstract_excerpt: 一些社会保险项目，包括美国的Medicare项目，允许受益人在公共和私人保险公司之间进行选择。在这类项目中，政府通常会向选择私人公司的人提供代金券。一个关键的政策决策是代金券的水平，而该决策的一个关键输入是公共选项与私人选项的参保人数相对于代金券规模的弹性。我们在Medicare项目中估计这一弹性，尽管该项目快速增长，但近期研究提供的关于Medicare Advantage（MA）参保如何对支付作出反应的证据却出奇地少。
36042.abstract: Some social insurance programs, including the Medicare program in the United States, allow beneficiaries to choose between public and private insurance firms. In these types of programs, the government will often provide a voucher to those who opt for private firms. A key policy decision is the level of this voucher, and a key input to that decision is the elasticity of enrollment in the public versus the private option with respect to the size of the voucher. We estimate this elasticity in the Medicare program, where recent work has provided remarkably little evidence on how Medicare Advantage (MA) enrollment responds to payment despite the program’s rapid growth. We leverage the fact that the formula determining county-level “benchmark” payments (vouchers) involves coarse thresholds based on county-level spending and counties occasionally move across these thresholds, providing a shock to the vouchers unrelated to beneficiary demand. Using several complementary estimation strategies, we find that a 1 percent increase in a county’s benchmark raises MA enrollment by roughly half a percentage point within three years, implying an elasticity of about 2. Applying this estimate to a policy counterfactual that sets benchmarks at 95 percent of county fee-for-service spending implies a decline in MA enrollment of about 6.1 percentage points, or roughly one-quarter of our sample. We also provide suggestive evidence, consistent with prior work, that the increase in benchmarks gets passed through in the form of additional benefits, providing a mechanism for the enrollment increases.

36041.title: Does Treating Addiction Rebuild Lives? Evidence from Buprenorphine
36041.zh_title: 治疗成瘾能重建生活吗？来自丁丙诺啡的证据
36041.authors: Sarah Eichmeyer, Aljoscha Janssen, Jonathan Zhang
36041.zh_abstract_excerpt: 治疗成瘾能改善经济状况以及健康吗？使用退伍军人健康管理局二十年来对超过140,000名阿片类药物使用障碍患者的记录和消费者信用数据，我们利用设施层面丁丙诺啡采用的交错推行和准随机的急诊医生分配。具有丁丙诺啡处方经验的临床医生比例增加五个百分点，使过量幸存者的长期药物使用翻倍，并使两年死亡率估计降低3.7个百分点。对接受治疗进行工具变量估计，得到22%的信用评分提升。
36041.abstract: Does treating addiction improve economic circumstances as well as health? Using two decades of Veterans Health Administration records on over 140,000 patients with opioid use disorder and consumer credit data, we exploit staggered facility-level buprenorphine adoption and quasi-random emergency physician assignment. A five-percentage-point increase in the share of clinicians with buprenorphine prescribing experience doubles overdose survivors’ long-term medication use and reduces two-year mortality by an estimated 3.7 percentage points. Instrumenting receipt yields a 22 percent credit score gain. At $300,000 per statistical life-year, estimated survival benefits alone exceed added medical costs within three years

36040.title: The Emergence of a National Capital Market,1870–1940
36040.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文利用首个长期、地理定位、企业层面的大型机构投资者资产持有记录，记录了美国资本市场的整合：1870–1940年寿险公司超过100,000笔持有。1880年至1890年间，保险公司债券距本地的平均距离增加了一倍以上，其本州份额从超过一半降至不到四分之一。这一转变发生在企业内部的债券类别和特许状之间。只要州法律允许，抵押贷款就是全国性的。到1890年，整合基本完成。
36040.abstract: This article documents the integration of the American capital market with the first long-run, geolocated, firm-level record of the asset holdings of large institutional investors: over 100,000 holdings of life insurers, 1870–1940. Between 1880 and 1890 the mean distance of insurers’ bonds from home more than doubled and their home-state share fell from over half to under a quarter. The shift occurred within firms, across bond classes and charters. Mortgage lending was national wherever state law permitted it. Integration was largely complete by 1890.

36039.title: Democratizing Venture Capital: Tax Incentives and the Geographic Expansion of Startup Investing
36039.zh_title: 风险投资的民主化：税收激励与创业投资的地理扩张
36039.zh_abstract_excerpt: 税收补贴能扩大创业投资的地理覆盖范围吗？尽管经历了数十年的增长，风险投资（VC）仍集中在少数大都市区，使全国大部分地区获得创业融资的机会有限。我们研究2009–2010年合格小企业股票（QSBS）计划的强化，该计划取消了对合格初创企业投资的联邦资本利得税。通过提高成功的回报，该改革使风险更高的投资更具吸引力，包括进入不熟悉的市场。这种激励对VC基金尤其强烈。
36039.abstract: Can tax subsidies expand the geographic reach of startup investing? Despite decades of growth, venture capital (VC) remains concentrated in a handful of metropolitan areas, leaving most of the country with limited access to startup financing. We study the 2009–2010 enhancement of the Qualified Small Business Stock (QSBS) program, which eliminated federal capital gains taxes on investments in qualifying startups. By raising the payoff to success, the reform made riskier investments more attractive, including entry into unfamiliar markets. This incentive is especially strong for VC funds. Relative to similarly sized metros that already had VC, the reform raised the probability that a previously unserved metro received VC investment in qualifying sectors by 8 to 10 percentage points. There was no comparable increase in sectors excluded from QSBS or among angel investors, who receive the same tax benefit. Startups in newly served markets performed like those in other non-hub markets, created high-wage jobs, and attracted scientific and technical workers, some from established hubs. Our findings suggest that a sufficiently large subsidy can extend VC into markets it had long bypassed, even with no requirement on where startups are located.

36038.title: Five Facts About Stablecoins
36038.zh_title: 关于稳定币的五个事实
36038.authors: Lin William Cong, Gordon Y. Liao, Eswar S. Prasad, Tony Zhang
36038.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们使用2020年至2025年的钱包级区块链数据记录了关于支付稳定币的五个事实。第一，稳定币充当交易货币：尽管供应量小得多，链上交易量仍超过比特币，流通速度急剧上升，交易已转向低价值转账。第二，利用交易时间改进基于交易所的归属，我们发现活动分布在美洲、欧洲和亚洲，且跨区域流动比标准方法所暗示的要少。第三，我们在持有数据上估计了一个结构性现金管理模型，发现自2023年以来访问稳定币钱包的成本已经下降。
36038.abstract: We document five facts about payment stablecoins using wallet-level blockchain data from 2020 to 2025. First, stablecoins serve as a transaction currency: onchain volume exceeds Bitcoin’s despite a much smaller supply, velocity has risen sharply, and transactions have shifted toward low-value transfers. Second, using transaction timing to refine exchange-based attribution, we find activity spread across the Americas, Europe, and Asia and fewer cross-regional flows than the standard method implies. Third, we estimate a structural cash-management model on the holdings data and find that the costs of accessing stablecoin wallets have fallen since 2023. Fourth, stablecoins are becoming the settlement currency of a fast-growing onchain credit market, and their growth appears to reallocate rather than destroy credit. Fifth, smart contracts are involved in about a third of Ethereum stablecoin transactions and over two thirds of volume, and protocols such as x402 demonstrate sub-cent machine-to-machine payments. Stablecoins behave as tokenized money, with implications for financial markets and regulation.

36037.title: Designing Low Emission Zones: Theory and Evidence
36037.zh_title: 设计低排放区：理论与证据
36037.authors: Nano Barahona, Natalia Fabra, Imelda Imelda, Juan-Pablo Montero
36037.zh_abstract_excerpt: 低排放区（LEZ）将污染车辆排除在城市部分地区之外，正在扩散。然而，其设计如何影响福利却鲜为人知。与价格工具不同，LEZ低效地配给通行权，对被限制车辆的非边际驾驶员施加成本。在我们的模型中，福利对LEZ规模是拟凸的，产生 bang-bang 原则：LEZ应尽可能大，或者根本不实施；更清洁的车辆（例如混合动力车）可以作为过渡技术获得豁免，但随后受到限制，这可能需要规划者的承诺。
36037.abstract: Low Emission Zones (LEZs), which exclude polluting vehicles from parts of a city, are spreading. Yet how their design affects welfare is poorly understood. Unlike price instruments, LEZs ration access inefficiently, imposing costs on inframarginal drivers of restricted vehicles. In our model, welfare is quasi-convex in LEZ size, yielding bang-bang principles: LEZs should be as large as possible or not implemented at all; cleaner vehicles (e.g., hybrids) could be exempt as transition technologies but later restricted, which may require planner commitment. Using new-car purchases, we find Madrid’s LEZ shifted buyers toward cleaner cars, but the surplus losses of switchers and inframarginal drivers exceeded emission savings.
